utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just checking—do we have the confirmed start time and where donations should be stored at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’m still confirming the exact start time and donation storage spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — once you have the start time and storage spot, please let me know so I can plan the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll check what tools and supplies are still missing, then send you a quick list so we can stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — that would help a lot. I’ll update the list once you send it and keep everything coordinated for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like Sunday at the community center, and I heard tools plus a few basics are still the main needs. If you want, I can pass along that you’re still looking for volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Nell — if you can spread the word about weekend volunteers, that’d help a lot. We still need a few more tools too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass along that you still need weekend volunteers and a few more tools. If I hear anyone who can help, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — it’s Sunday at the community center now. We still need a few supplies and some hands-on help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — could you send me the exact supply list and where help is still needed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll send the supply list and the spots where we still need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — do we have the confirmed start time for Sunday yet?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not yet, Mina — I’m confirming the start time now, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — please let me know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I may have missed the latest list, but I can drop the supplies at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ve got the latest list and you’re dropping the supplies at the community center on Sunday, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I may have missed the latest list, but yes, I’ll drop the supplies off at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in — just tell me what you still need from me for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just the final time for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll spread it to everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll confirm the final Sunday time and send it your way as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there Sunday at the community center, right on time. Just let me know if you still need anything from me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Sunday at the community center is the plan — thanks for being there on time, Eli!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course, Tess. I’ll keep it simple and be ready to help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sending the time window and task list over shortly, Opal. That should make the next drop-off spot easy to keep track of.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep track of the next drop-off spot and wait for the Sunday time window and task list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send it over shortly, and I’ll keep it clear and simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’ll send the final task list and photos soon, so you can jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Leo — send them when you can, and I’ll be ready to help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the final task list and photos shortly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right — it’s on Sunday at the community center now. If you’re able, setup is the first thing I could use help with.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help with setup and I’ll keep spreading the word. Just let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check the exact time and get back to you. For now, Sunday at the community center is the place, and setup help would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for any repair needs while I’m running errands and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. Send me anything you spot, and I’ll keep the Sunday repair drive list updated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out now, so I’ll pass along anything I hear about the repair drive supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep everyone posted on what to bring and when to arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve got Sunday at the community center noted, and I’ll wait for the bring list and arrival time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send the bring list and arrival time as soon as I finalize them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center now. If you can bring tools, that’d be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring my tool kit Sunday to the community center. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to handle.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Gus — could you help with the heavier fixes and maybe keep an eye on the tool table? I’ll pass along the update to everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — once the start time and donation spot are posted, I can help point folks the right way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll post the start time and donation drop-off spot as soon as I confirm them. Thanks for helping guide folks on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — once those details are posted, I can help direct people at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send you the time and exact spot as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Uli — I’ll pass it along to everyone as soon as you send it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate it, Quinn. I’ll send the details over soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what do you still need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just the headcount and any tool notes you have, Kira. That’ll keep Sunday at the community center nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll send the headcount and any tool notes over. Just confirming, Sunday at the community center is still the plan?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’m still waiting on the time, and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking on the repair-drive time, Nell, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep watching for the time and any updates.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still no confirmed start time yet? I just need that so I can plan the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I must’ve missed the latest update too—do we have a confirmed start time yet? I’m still in and can help once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet — once we’ve got the start time, I can lock in the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — I’m just confirming the final time and any supplies still needed for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I still need the confirmed start time for Sunday at the community center so I can plan the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll confirm the start time and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rey — I’ve got you down. We still need a couple more volunteers plus any tools or supplies you can bring for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can bring a few tools and help find more volunteers for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll keep an eye out for the updated time and list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the updated time and list as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Vik — I’ll keep my schedule flexible and wait for the update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a huge help at the tool table. I still need to check the start time with Rosa, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — just let me know the start time and I’ll be there to help sort and label.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’m checking with Rosa now and I’ll pass along the start time as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — I’ve got the Sunday community center update, and I’ll keep an eye out for the final list and photos.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes on the final list or photos.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I’ll pass it along if anyone asks while I’m out running errands.
